purpose: Collector throughput only; no training or promotion
limitations: Four-turn rollouts are not full completed games or a playing-strength evaluation.
The matched protocol benchmark uses the new encoder in both paths; it isolates the transport change rather than the entire old implementation.
The confirmation fixes batch32/wait1 for both worker counts; its combined ratio is not a direct measurement against old production batch16/wait5 settings.

CPU opponents are wall-time limited; 32 workers reduced aggregate CPU searched nodes by about 8% versus16 and some opponent moves changed. Saved teacher labels and learner simulation budgets were unchanged.
Two repeats on the same 16 replay states establish a useful measured setting, not a confidence interval or universal optimum.
The live training VM was not modified; selected settings apply to a future resume.
